Today’s M&A briefing — 19 deals, the strategies behind them · 11 November 2026

🔹 UC Partners (private equity fund) acquires a stake in stake in Monkey Puzzle Day Nurseries (network of 80 nurseries in the UK with significant franchise activity) — £23m.

🔹 Berlin (État allemand) acquires a stake in KNDS (franco-German group manufacturing the Leopard 2 tank).

🔹 KPS Capital (private equity fund specializing) acquires MM Packaging (global manufacturer of folding cartons, labels, and leaflets).
MM Packaging is a subsidiary of Mayr-Melnhof Karton AG (MM Group), which retains 30% of the new independent entity.

🔹 Dragados (filiale de Grupo ACS) (construction and infrastructure subsidiary of the Spanish group ACS) finalizes the acquisition of Grupo Voltan (engineering specializing in electrical transmission and distribution).

🔹 Avanade acquires Robiquity (business process automation consultancy using Power Platform, Copilot).

🔹 Boluda Shipping (filiale de Boluda Corporación Marítima) (logistics subsidiary of the Valencian group Boluda Corporación Marítima, operator of maritime and rail terminals) acquires Matrans (maritime terminal in Eemhaven, Rotterdam, handling containers).

🔹 AcegasApsAmga (filiale de Hera) (subsidiary of the Bologna-based multi-utility Hera) acquires Gigas Rete (verona-based gas distribution company in 23 municipalities).

🔹 SYS-DAT (company listed on Euronext STAR Milan active in ICT) acquires 60 % du capital de Soluzione 1 (publisher of proprietary digitalization solutions).

🔹 AATech (benefit company listed on Euronext Growth Milan) acquires a majority stake in Scenari Immobiliari (independent institute for studies, analyses, valuations).

🔹 LMI Technologies (groupe TKH) (TKH group company specializing in industrial machine vision) finalizes the acquisition of VITRONIC's Weld Seam Inspection (WSI) division (3D inline weld seam inspection systems).

🔹 Vanta acquires Pillar Security (AI agent security platform capable of actively testing them and intervening in real-time when they exceed their authorized perimeter).

🔹 GreenDot (european operator of extended producer responsibility and plastics recycling) acquires 50 % du capital de Valorie (holding company for French EPR organizations Léko (household packaging and paper) and Léko Pro (industrial and commercial packaging)).

🔹 AerFin (welsh aerospace asset management specialist based in Newport) acquires 44 Boeing 737NG et leurs 88 moteurs CFM56-7B (fleet of 44 end-of-life Boeing 737NGs and 88 CFM56-7B engines).

➕ 6 more deals in the carousel.

en.text:
Today’s fundraising briefing — 6 deals, the strategies behind them · 11 November 2026

🔹 Sumary (AI platform for accounting firms and financial teams: workflow automation, transaction verification, and data transformation) — €22m · Seed.
Founded in 2025, Sumary already works with the majority of the top 20 Nordic firms, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton, and Baker Tilly. This round comes less than a year after a €3.7 million pre-seed.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: By selling to large Nordic firms from the outset, Sumary is betting on a B2B2B distribution: if Deloitte or Grant Thornton adopt the platform, they indirectly impose it on their SME clients, bypassing the difficulty of direct acquisition in a fragmented market.

🔹 Noctua Science Ventures (austrian pre-seed fund dedicated to deeptech spin-offs from Austrian universities and research institutions) — €15m. Fundraising in progress — target amount, not yet closed.
Noctua originated from a joint venture between Speedinvest and TU Wien, joined by TU Graz, Montanuniversität Leoben, BOKU, and JKU Linz. Speedinvest acts as the regulatory manager (AIFM). First closing reached at €15 million.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Erste Group, Verbund X Ventures, Austria Wirtschaftsservice (aws), Allocator One — first closing at €15M.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Noctua invests exclusively in spin-offs backed by years of research and robust IP, drawing a clear line in a market where the boundary between deeptech and ordinary AI applications is blurring.

🔹 Light Frame (modular banking infrastructure, core banking, and portfolio management for private banks, wealth managers, and asset managers) — $5m · Seed.
Founded in 2024, Light Frame had raised $1.7 million in pre-seed. Its CEO Schuyler Weiss is the former CEO of the Swiss digital private bank Alpian.
𝗨𝘀𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗳𝘂𝗻𝗱𝘀: Platform development and commercial expansion in EMEA.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Fortino Ventures (lead investor); Sidekick Partners, Tenity, Chamaeleon, AltaIR Capital, Rogue Venture Partners, New Stack Ventures, Studio Alpha.
𝗢𝘂𝗿 𝘃𝗶𝗲𝘄: Light Frame relies on a modular architecture allowing private banks to replace individual components without full migration, reducing perceived risk and shortening the sales cycle in a notoriously slow-to-modernize market.

🔹 Heal.dev (AI agent for bug and application vulnerability detection, exploring applications as they are actually used, French startup) — €4m.
𝗜𝗻𝘃𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘀: Mango Capital, Alven.

🔹 Agent F (AI-native ERP platform to automate accounting, financial control, and planning in high-growth companies, based in Berlin) — $4m · Pre-seed.

🔹 Humbird (nantes-based manufacturer of light intermediate vehicles with electrically assisted collective pedaling, WoodyBus) — €1.1m.

🔹 Sumary (𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝐼𝐴 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑐𝑎𝑏𝑖𝑛𝑒𝑡𝑠 𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑝𝑡𝑎𝑏𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑒́𝑞𝑢𝑖𝑝𝑒𝑠 𝑓𝑖𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑖𝑒̀𝑟𝑒𝑠 : 𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑜𝑚𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑠𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑓𝑙𝑢𝑥 𝑑𝑒 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑣𝑎𝑖𝑙, 𝑣𝑒́𝑟𝑖𝑓𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑎𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑡𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑠𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑜𝑛𝑛𝑒́𝑒𝑠) — 22 M€ · Seed.
Fondée en 2025, Sumary travaille déjà avec la majorité des 20 plus grands cabinets nordiques, dont Deloitte, Grant Thornton et Baker Tilly. Ce tour intervient moins d'un an après une pré-seed de 3,7 millions d'euros.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : En vendant aux grands cabinets nordiques dès l'amorçage, Sumary mise sur une distribution B2B2B : si Deloitte ou Grant Thornton adoptent la plateforme, ils l'imposent indirectement à leurs clients PME, contournant la difficulté d'acquisition directe dans un marché fragmenté.

🔹 Noctua Science Ventures (𝑓𝑜𝑛𝑑𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑝𝑟𝑒́-𝑠𝑒𝑒𝑑 𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑐ℎ𝑖𝑒𝑛 𝑑𝑒́𝑑𝑖𝑒́ 𝑎𝑢𝑥 𝑠𝑝𝑖𝑛-𝑜𝑓𝑓𝑠 𝑑𝑒𝑒𝑝𝑡𝑒𝑐ℎ 𝑑𝑒𝑠 𝑢𝑛𝑖𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑠𝑖𝑡𝑒́𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑖𝑛𝑠𝑡𝑖𝑡𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑟𝑒𝑐ℎ𝑒𝑟𝑐ℎ𝑒 𝑎𝑢𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑐ℎ𝑖𝑒𝑛𝑛𝑒𝑠) — 15 M€. Levée en cours — montant visé, non encore bouclé.
Noctua est issu d'une coentreprise entre Speedinvest et TU Wien, rejointe par TU Graz, Montanuniversität Leoben, BOKU et JKU Linz. Speedinvest agit comme gestionnaire réglementaire (AIFM). Premier closing atteint à 15 millions d'euros.
𝗣𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘁 𝗱𝗲 𝘃𝘂𝗲 : Noctua investit exclusivement dans des spin-offs adossés à des années de recherche et à une PI robuste, traçant une ligne claire dans un marché où la frontière entre deeptech et application IA ordinaire devient floue.

🔹 Light Frame (𝑖𝑛𝑓𝑟𝑎𝑠𝑡𝑟𝑢𝑐𝑡𝑢𝑟𝑒 𝑏𝑎𝑛𝑐𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒 𝑚𝑜𝑑𝑢𝑙𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒) — 5 M$ · Seed.
Fondée en 2024, Light Frame avait levé 1,7 million de dollars en pré-seed. Son CEO Schuyler Weiss est l'ancien CEO de la banque privée digitale suisse Alpian.
𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗳 : Développement de la plateforme et expansion commerciale en EMEA.

🔹 Heal.dev (𝑎𝑔𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝐼𝐴 𝑑𝑒 𝑑𝑒́𝑡𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛 𝑑𝑒 𝑏𝑢𝑔𝑠 𝑒𝑡 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑢𝑙𝑛𝑒́𝑟𝑎𝑏𝑖𝑙𝑖𝑡𝑒́𝑠 𝑎𝑝𝑝𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑣𝑒𝑠 𝑒𝑥𝑝𝑙𝑜𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑎𝑝𝑝𝑙𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑜𝑛𝑠 𝑡𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑞𝑢'𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑠𝑜𝑛𝑡 𝑟𝑒́𝑒𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡 𝑢𝑡𝑖𝑙𝑖𝑠𝑒́𝑒𝑠, 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑟𝑡𝑢𝑝 𝑓𝑟𝑎𝑛𝑐̧𝑎𝑖𝑠𝑒) — 4 M€.
𝗔𝘃𝗲𝗰 : Mango Capital, Alven.

🔹 Agent F (𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑓𝑜𝑟𝑚𝑒 𝐸𝑅𝑃 𝑛𝑎𝑡𝑖𝑣𝑒 𝐼𝐴) — 4 M$ · Pré-seed.

🔹 Humbird (𝑓𝑎𝑏𝑟𝑖𝑐𝑎𝑛𝑡 𝑛𝑎𝑛𝑡𝑎𝑖𝑠 𝑑𝑒 𝑣𝑒́ℎ𝑖𝑐𝑢𝑙𝑒𝑠 𝑙𝑒́𝑔𝑒𝑟𝑠 𝑖𝑛𝑡𝑒𝑟𝑚𝑒́𝑑𝑖𝑎𝑖𝑟𝑒𝑠 𝑎̀ 𝑝𝑒́𝑑𝑎𝑙𝑎𝑔𝑒 𝑐𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑓 𝑎𝑠𝑠𝑖𝑠𝑡𝑒́ 𝑒́𝑙𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑟𝑖𝑞𝑢𝑒𝑚𝑒𝑛𝑡, 𝑊𝑜𝑜𝑑𝑦𝐵𝑢𝑠, 7 𝑒𝑡 9 𝑝𝑙𝑎𝑐𝑒𝑠 𝑝𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑐𝑜𝑙𝑙𝑒𝑐𝑡𝑖𝑣𝑖𝑡𝑒́𝑠) — 1,1 M€.
